tex_content.html:
Corollary
[$r + s = n$, without a basis]

↗ lem:radical-scalar-product-trivial ↗ prop:sylvesters-law-inertia

If an $n$-dimensional scalar product space has signature $(r,s)$, then $r+s=n$.

Proof

↗ lem:radical-scalar-product-trivial ↗ prop:sylvesters-law-inertia \sketch The positive index, negative index, and radical dimension of a quadratic form sum to $\dim V$. Here they are $r$, $s$, and $0$.

□

The integer $s$ in (2.23) is the index of $q$, and $(r,s)$ is its signature.
